Hi <data_privacy_customer_full_name>,    


We take our customer’s data very seriously and safeguarding our customer's personal information is our top priority. As part of our commitment to data privacy, we comply with data privacy regulations.

To ensure that your data is protected, we provide you with the option to exercise your rights to download, export, stop selling and sharing, and deletion of your personal information. To do so, please visit the "Exercise your rights" section in the link below.

We encourage you to read our privacy policy for more details on how we collect, process, and utilize your personal information. You can find the link to our privacy policy here.

Thank you for your trust in <dealership_name>. 

Best regards,
<dealership_name> Team
